name: code-explorer
title: CodeExplorer (ce)
description: Local architecture-intelligence MCP server. Indexes a codebase into an OpenCypher knowledge graph (projects, symbols, calls, data lineage) and exposes architecture map, dependency, call-chain, impact-analysis and Semantic Invariant Gate tools to AI coding agents.
dataHandling: Runs entirely on the developer machine; source code and the graph database never leave the workspace.
